title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
company_profile: InnoWave Technologies is a Bangalore-based SaaS company building workflow automation platforms for large enterprises across India and Southeast Asia.
description:
Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI
- Build and optimize REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients
- Work with PostgreSQL and Redis for high-performance data access
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews
- Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews

You will collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable and secure services in a fast-paced environment.
requirements:
5+ years of backend development experience
Strong proficiency in Python
Experience with REST APIs, SQL databases, Docker, and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
Good understanding of system design and microservices
benefits: Health insurance, ESOPs, annual performance bonus, hybrid work model.
